"""Scale probes: exercise the coupled documented bounds and watch the clock."""
import base64, json, random, struct, subprocess, sys, time
import kit

def timeit(label, fn):
    start = time.time()
    value = fn()
    print("%-28s %6.2fs" % (label, time.time() - start))
    return value, time.time() - start


# ---------- many objects: 2048 runs x 1024 slots --------------------------
def make_many_objects(runs=2048, slots=1024):
    types = [{"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
             {"name": "AR", "kind": "array", "element": "I", "size": slots}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["a", "AR"]], "result": ["r", "I"],
                "requires": None}]
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    assert plan["variables"] == slots + 2 + 1, plan["variables"]
    count = len(plan["slots"])
    print("objects per run", count)
    payloads = []
    for index in range(runs):
        objs = [(n, struct.pack("<I", (index + i) & 0xFFFFFFFF))
                for i, (n, p, w) in enumerate(plan["slots"])]
        objs.append(("x%d" % (plan["variables"] - 1), b"\x00")) if False else None
        payloads.append({"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs)})
    campaign["runs"] = payloads
    return campaign


campaign, _ = timeit("build 2M objects", lambda: make_many_objects())
out, seconds = timeit("campaign: 2M objects", lambda: kit.run_cli(campaign))
print("records", out["records"][0], len(out["corpus"]))
assert len(out["corpus"]) == 2048

# ---------- deep nesting: 64 levels of struct/array ----------------------
def deep(size=8, levels=64):
    types = [{"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
    previous = "I"
    for level in range(levels):
        if level % 2:
            types.append({"name": "S%d" % level, "kind": "struct",
                          "fields": [["f", previous]]})
            current = "S%d" % level
        else:
            types.append({"name": "A%d" % level, "kind": "array",
                          "element": previous, "size": 1})
            current = "A%d" % level
        previous = current
    types.append({"name": "TOP", "kind": "alias", "target": previous})
    types.append({"name": "B", "kind": "bool"})
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["p", "TOP"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                "requires": ["eq", ["field", ["var", "p"], "f"], ["const", "I", 1]]}]
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    print("deep variables", plan["variables"], "slots", len(plan["slots"]),
          "path depth", len(plan["slots"][0][1]))
    assert plan["variables"] == levels + 2
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [1])] +
        [("r_slot", b"\x00")][0:0] + [])}]
    return campaign


deep_campaign = deep()
out = kit.run_cli(deep_campaign)
print(out["records"][:2])

# ---------- wide ids: one entry with 65536 reserved IDs ------------------
def wide():
    types = [{"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 1},
             {"name": "R", "kind": "array", "element": "I", "size": 32768},
             {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["a", "R"], ["b", "B"]],
                "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    print("wide ids", plan["variables"], "slots", len(plan["slots"]))
    objs = [(n, kit.leaf(w, 1)) for n, p, w in plan["slots"]]
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs)} for _ in range(4)]
    return campaign


out, seconds = timeit("wide ids", lambda: kit.run_cli(wide()))
print(out["records"])
PYEOF
